name: Indonesia

nationalGame.name: Badminton
nationalGame.about: Badminton is Indonesia's proudest sport — Olympic golds and world titles galore.
nationalGame.note: Indonesia has no official national sport — badminton is the nation's favourite.

loved.name: Badminton
loved.why: Indonesian champions are superstars, and fans fill whole stadiums.

loved.name: Football
loved.why: Local league matches are loud, colourful and packed.

loved.name: Sepak Takraw
loved.why: An acrobatic favourite across the islands.

fact: Indonesia's very first Olympic gold medal came from badminton in 1992 — Susi Susanti's win made the whole country celebrate.
